definition: Sexual or intimate activity that happens before another sexual activity, often to build arousal, comfort, or intimacy.
details: Foreplay can include different kinds of affectionate or sexual interaction. What people enjoy varies between individuals, and consent and comfort matter. It can also be the main event itself, not only something before intercourse. It helps with lubrication, erection and relaxation, and makes sex more comfortable. It's especially important for many people with a vulva to reach orgasm. There's no set order or time; communication matters more than technique.
